CosmosDb._comment: Real shared account (pilotai), PB_ database only. No AccountKey on purpose — auth goes through Azure AD (DefaultAzureCredential), resolved from `az login`, scoped to the Cosmos DB Data Contributor role on /dbs/PB_ThePainterBoysDb only.

GoogleAuth._comment: Shared 'TeasHarness Web' OAuth client already in use by other pilotai-account projects (see deployment.md). localhost:5173 must be added to its Authorized JavaScript origins in Google Cloud Console before sign-in will actually succeed locally.

BlobStorage._comment: Project WIP-photo storage. No account key — DefaultAzureCredential, same as Cosmos. Local dev resolves via `az login`, which needs the Storage Blob Data Contributor role on this account.

SheetSync._comment: ApiKey deliberately omitted here — same pattern as the secrets above. Set via SheetSync__ApiKey in Azure app settings; the admin-JWT auth path works fine locally without it.
